text:
mina_kim: FYI partner asks: quick recipe for Datadog + OTel to show LLM traces and a dashboard tile in marketplace listing. Can we make a tiny repo?

oliver_reed: Yes — minimal checklist: collector config, dashboard JSON, demo curl that produces a trace id, QA steps. No PII.

sam_taylor: Runtime notes: span names should include model and route, emit kv_cache.hit metric, and include batch_size as attribute. Sampling: recommend head-based 1% + tail sampler for slow requests.

observability-bot: Templates uploaded to partners/telemetry-golden-path/v1 (collector.yaml, dd-dashboard.json, demo.sh).

mina_kim: Ops wants runbook blurb: if p99 > 500ms check GPU util, queue depth, and fallback model switch.

oliver_reed: I'll produce the collector example and pull request the dashboard JSON.

sam_taylor: I'll add span examples and a short trace export file.

mina_kim: Timeline: draft by Wed, review Tue 10am. Thanks!
